children: Alkermes reported positive topline phase 1b proof-of-concept results for ALKS 7290 showing clinically meaningful ADHD symptom improvements and tolerability.
Phase 1b: ALKS 7290 showed dose-dependent, clinically meaningful AISRS reductions of 14 pts (20 mg) and 19 pts (50 mg) at day 14.
CGI-S: Median CGI-S improved by 1.0 (20 mg) and 2.0 (50 mg), shifting severity toward mildly ill at day 14.
Safety: ALKS 7290 was generally well tolerated; no serious TEAEs and no discontinuations among treated participants.
Biomarkers: EEG and cognitive tests showed central activity and benefits across processing speed, working memory and attention.
Development: Phase 2 in adults with ADHD is enrolling (~312 planned); first participant dosed Sept. 2026, data expected in 2027.

title: Alkermes Announces Positive Phase 1b Results for ALKS 7290 in Adults With ADHD
